notes.title: Version 4.7 - Rocket League
notes.content:
[u]Big features[/u]
- Medals added with a specific goal time for each challenge.
- 5 new challenges added... but they're for the release.
- Seeds can be set, to race others with the same seed or optimize a specific seed.
- Room locations and challenge settings have been renamed internally.

[u]Small features[/u]
- The house can be bigger than the map size, and it will follow the player around in that case.
- Map is centered vertically when there are less than 3 floors.
- Holes can loop from the right of the house to the left.
- An additional present appears next to the player if they should start with upgrades at the start of a challenge.
- Run count added per challenge, along with the best seeded time.
- LB and RB can be used to navigate the title scene and the settings.
- Game pauses when the current gamepad gets disconnected.
- UHD & 4K resolutions are disabled, they made the title screen lag a lot.
- Screen resolution is applied immediately in Windowed modes.
- Game scale is increased by default on small screens.
- Timer continues to run when turning the Steamdeck off.
- Improved the generation algorithm, which should make smaller maps easier to generate.
- Checks can be interacted with as soon as the player is grounded, not one frame after.
- Suri can talk to Homa while the printer is printing.
- Holes can be forced in the challenge configuration.

[u]Gameplay Tweaks[/u]
- Vertical holes removed from Portal Palace.
- Cheese jump is resetted when using the rocket.

[u]Level Design[/u]
- Some logic fixes.
- New Expert logic tricks added.
- Explosives should explose less in the face of the player in some situation (e.g. in the truck).
- It's not possible anymore to go in the basement pipe with only the cheese jump.
- Basement upper shelf has been lowered a bit to align with the staircase.

[u]Graphics[/u]
- Challenge paintings remade.

[u]Sound[/u]
- Hit pitch decreases if the player uses the same move many times in a row in the arcade fighting game.
- Pins don't make a noise after a while when thrown through a hole.

[u]Writing[/u]
- Naro's specific event now happens at the end of day 9 instead of day 8.

[u]Bugs[/u]
- The game froze for a bit every time it auto-saved.
- Monitor was sometimes not correctly restored on game startup.
- Changing the gamepad rumble force in-game correctly applies it right away.
- Some microwave and laundry fast cycles started even though there were many reachable checks.
- Audible click removed when entering the Living room.
- Mati can't give an onion to the player for her clean toque.
- Vyna wasn't aware you needed Polo's voice to give him the medallion.
- It was possible to cheese slam the top corner of the wall holes to gain extra height.
- Cheese slamming at the same frame you fall down a platform made the player disappear.
- Player can't cheese slam while riding the hot air balloon.
- Player was able to get out of bounds while entering a zone.
- The exit door is not hidden anymore when in the garage rail door.
- Pressing A just a frame after receiving a present from a Gacha Machine will correctly place a coin in the machine and not jump.
- Mouse cursor should disappear when playing with a gamepad.
- Treasure chests in the bathroom cabinet can't be revealed if the glass hasn't been broken.
- Hot milk will not cool down faster if the player doesn't have Yero's voice.
- Interiors are correctly hidden when the current room is unloaded while the interior content is fading out.

notes.title: 4.6 Release - The Sexy Brutale
notes.content:
[u]Big Features[/u]
- Spanish language added in the demo.
- Chinese language added in the demo.
- Run saves won't be deleted on version change from now on.
- Steam Cloud really works, for real this time.

[u]Small features[/u]
- Brightness slider added in the option.
- Auto-skip heard dialog option added.
- Fortune cookie in Day 2 replaced by a map upgrade.
- Cursor is confined inside the screen when playing with the mouse.
- Cursor can loop in the menus.
- Resolution list is updated after changing monitor.
- Update tracker can be moved to accomodate for the streamer camera.

[u]Gameplay Tweaks[/u]
- Suri can try to give the Hot Milk to Yero even when the sprites are shuffled.

[u]Level Design[/u]
- Office stool now has wooden feet.
- Living armchair arm platform is wider.
- Some logic fixes.
- Some Advanced & Expert tricks added.
- Suri can stand on the radio front handle.

[u]Writing[/u]
- Some changes here and there in English and French.
- Special dialog added if Polo received a hot coffe that went cold.

[u]Bugs[/u]
- OHKO achievement is not awarded if player received fire damage.
- The player could be Soft-locked in day 10 with Miko's key not appearing.
- Quitting a run while on the rocket broke some platforms.
- Babyroom dresser drawer could sometimes stay closed on save reload.
- Babyroom dollhouse checks were sometimes shifted on the map.
- The player sometimes can go through some platforms when grappling down.
- Vyna's hint was sometimes not correctly marked as completed after a save reload.
- Quest bubbles above the NPCs were not always correctly restored after a save reload.

- New Title music.

- Kitchen, Bathroom & Laundry musics modified, still in the same theme.

[u]Sound[/u]
- High jump sound added.
- Chest open sound modified.

- Tupi has been renamed to Suri.
- Some item descriptions remade.

[u]Bugs[/u]

notes.title: 4.4 Release - Katamari Damacy
notes.content:
[u]Big Features[/u]
- Disorderly Dwelling challenge added.
- Challenge room now shows the best time for each challenge.
- Logic levels added (Beginner (default for the campaign), Advanced (default for challenges) and Expert).

[u]Small Features[/u]
- The number of holes between two zones can be changed in the settings.
- StartZone, ExitZone and ExitHole values in the settings can be defined by their geographical positions.
- Cold items do not emit heat particles when they replace a hot item.
- Items being washed are visible inside the washing machine.
- Fortune cookie texts will not repeat during the run.
- Vyna emits a sound when the hint prompt appears.
- Tupi is caught by a scoop net when warping out of a stuck location.
- Hints add a penalty of 30 seconds in the final time.

[u]Level Design[/u]
- It's easier to go to the first shelf of the living room with the cheese jump.
- Garage car top is aligned with the wall holes.
- Pins treasure chests are easier to aim at.
- Fixed some logic issues.

[u]Gameplay Tweaks[/u]
- Rocket snaps to the ground only if the player is close to the ground.
- Timer continues running when the game is paused.

[u]Graphics[/u]
- Challenge room remade.
- Justine icon added when Ligu waits for the player to check on her.
- Randomized blanket integration improved on Tana's sprite.
- Four paintings added.

[u]Writing[/u]
- Some dialogs are skipped when item icons are randomized.
- Tupi doesn't say more ink cartridges are required before actually trying to print the document.

[u]Bugs[/u]
- Popi stops talking when he's hidden in the armchair.
- It was possible to clip through the ground with the fire slam.
- The Cheese Slam sometimes didn't trigger the gramophone or the printer.
- Some pins were visible while inside the dollhouse or the car trunk.
- Some items were possibly duplicated in some campaign runs.
- Gamepad upgrades tracker was sometimes not restored after a run reload.
- Player's position was restored to the start of the level after exiting the game twice without moving.
- Some quest checks were marked as out of logic even though they were legit.
- NPCs quest marker wasn't shown correctly after revealing them in a fire-locked location.
- Backup save files are correctly loaded if the main save file has been corrupted.

notes.title: 4.3 Release - Octodad
notes.content:
[u]Big Features[/u]
- Item icons can be shuffled.
- Gacha machines and NPCs can be shuffled independently in their own group.
- Voice sounds can be shuffled.
- Mad Abode challenge added.
- Keyboard & mouse layout added for the upgrade tracker.
- Saves are now encrypted files stored in the AppData folder.

[u]Small Features[/u]
- Screen resolution can be changed in the settings.
- NPCs, Gacha machines and treasure chests can also trigger the no logic achievement.
- Item highlight stops once we give the item to an NPC.
- Sticky note is shown in Homa's bubble until the player finds it.
- Vyna can give hints even if you don't have the map.
- Trebuchet bomb can be lit before used, useless but cool.
- Exiting the game in a tutorial will replay the tutorial when reloading the campaign.
- Backup saves added, to prevent losing data if something bad occurs while saving.

[u]Controls[/u]
- On keyboard, Interacting is now done with F (was E).
- On keyboard, Firecrackers are now thrown with E (was F).
- On keyboard, Lighter is not used with Q (or A on azerty layouts) (was Ctrl).
- On keyboard, Cheese Slam is now triggered with Ctrl (was Alt, Cmd, Z, X or C).

[u]Level Design[/u]
- Dropping down from the top of the minibar to the bottles platform isn't possible anymore without the cheese jump.
- Using the grapple to go from inside the bath to the sink now successfully brings you out of the bath every time.
- Moved a bit the bathroom cupboard platforms so it's clearer which type of jump you need.
- Moved the bathroom center and right shelves a bit to prevent easy logic breaks by using the coyote time.
- Can't jump to the office chair with only the double cheese jump.
- Can of cat food added on the kitchen floor to facilitate going inside the fridge with the double cheese jump.
- Many logic fixes.

[u]Gameplay Tweaks[/u]
- Rocket and Cheese Slam can't be abused to reach higher platforms easily anymore.

[u]Graphics[/u]
- Mati's toque sprite redrawn.
- Bari's nail icon redrawn.
- All icons now feature variants when you stack them.
- No logic stamp added when obtaining an out-of-logic item.
- Yero now has a mouth.
- Fire slam buttons are now cyan.
- New painting added.

[u]Sound[/u]
- Only one glass break sound will play when multiple bottles explode at the same time.
- Successive glass break sounds will increase in pitch.

[u]Writing[/u]
- Bari invites the player to try the machine after being built.
- New dialog when Yero doesn't has his voice, and doesn't speak through the baby monitor.
- End of Pirate Paradise laboratory session modified.
- New fortune cookie texts.

[u]Bugs[/u]
- Pins & Grapple treasure charts in mirrored zones will be also mirrored correctly.
- Charged Pins treasure chests will correctly be revealed even if the pin is triggered directly.
- Workshop bust is correctly removed on save reload.
- Garage upper hole door "drop" animation fixed.
- Firecrackers don't fall through the shower bottles holder when moving away.
- Yero's tablet animation doesn't scale up and down anymore.
- Starting the cheese slam and being hit on the same frame glitched the cheese slam in a stuck state.
- Screen shake stops when pausing the game.

- Candle replaced by a ice slab in the dollhouse.

[u]Gameplay Tweaks[/u]

[u]Graphics[/u]

- Changed some parts of Roky's dialogs.
- Tupi doesn't say to Fura he can destroy the baby monitor if he doesn't have the dynamite.
- Tupi says a special line if he already has 2 nails when talking to Bari.
- New dialog when Naro wants a tent before Higa had a chance to ask for one.
- Improved english dialogs overall.
- More secret dialogs.

[u]Bugs[/u]
- Suspending a run while in a stuck zone will not the "unstuck warp" mechanic anymore.
- Dying in a tutorial while being hit doesn't softlock the game anymore.
- Tupi can't use the Cheese Slam in narrow places.
- The Cheese Slam won't be canceled when triggering it under a one-way platform.
- The Cheese Slam can now be spammed while overlapping a one-way platform.
- Reloading a save doesn't show a negative last auto-save time.
- Homa's password quest was shown as non-completable if the player already typed the password.
- Vyna could incorrectly tell the player they can give toothpicks to Roky even though they don't have any.
- Garage Arcade incorrectly didn't require the Cheese Slam to be won.

notes.title: 4.1.1 Release - Ocarina of Time
notes.content:
The complete home is finally there!
This major update features new rooms, new NPCs, new musics and new challenges!

Also, your progression inside a run can now be saved and restored later.

Here's a partial changelog (too many stuff was done to fit here):

[h2]Big Features[/h2]
- Workshop and Garage added in the basement.
- Babyroom and Parental Bedroom added on the second floor.
- Bathroom has been remade.
- Bico & Coli join the family, and they want to build machines.
- Sero & Fura join the family, being a parent is difficult.
- Bona joins the family, and she just wants to relax.
- Roky, Andy and Roly join the family, and they want to make some noise.
- 3 more challenges await in the campaign: Full House, Twisted Estate and Nomad Mice.
- Runs are automatically saved and can be resumed later.

[h2]Small Features[/h2]
- Quests asking for too many collectibles can't be picked too early.
- Microwave & Washing machine fast cycles automatically start when there are too few checks remaining to open.
- Cheese Slam can be triggered simply by pressing RB.
- Check locations can be dynamic, and may or may not appear in the dollhouse.

[h2]Level Design[/h2]
- Firecrackers tutorial has safety cheeses to prevent falling at the end.
- Tutorials are overall easier to complete with less chance for failure.
- Living room shelves are not equidistant, making some obvious you can't use the cheese jump to access them.
- Dining room chairs are easier to climb with the pins.
- Dining room top buffet part is hidden during the first visit.
- Hanging pot added in office.
- Office desk is not metallic anymore.
- Office chair legs are not wooden anymore, but the desk feet are.
- Toilet litter can be exitted with a simple drop-down.
- Bathroom cupboard top can only be accessed with the Double Cheese Jump.
- Tupi can stand on the bottles in the basement shelf.
- Vyna in the Tutoroom has been moved inside the minibar.

[h2]Gameplay Tweaks[/h2]
- Polo now keeps the Gourmet Medallion.
- Charged pins makes Tupi go a bit higher.
- Tupi doesn't cheese jump when holding the stick down, probably preparing for a drop down.

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
- The item get popup window is more animated.
- Treasure charts are now drawn on sticky notes.
- Ropes added on the upgrades UI to emphasize it's a representation of a gamepad.
- A pink heart has been added on Homa's print, to better see if Magenta is required.

[h2]Sound[/h2]
- Sounds added when the item popup appears.
- Clock gong added every hour.

[h2]Writing[/h2]
- Some dialogs improved here and there.
- Homa now asks to type the password for her.
- New Chinese Cookie messages.

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
- Texts don't overflow from the item get box anymore.
- Popi's mouth was misplaced after he drinks his lemonade.
- Ironing table should work correctly now.
